scope: Necessary source-field projections only; not damage/physics/attribution/engine qualification

cases.name: unchanged_live_handoff
cases.source_basis: No actor action changes the source-required protected fields.

cases.name: opposing_kill_credit_800
cases.source_basis: _eliminated gives one opposing kill and mini(9000, credits+300). Projection validates necessary award fields, not damage attribution.

cases.name: opposing_kill_credit_8800
cases.source_basis: _eliminated gives one opposing kill and mini(9000, credits+300). Projection validates necessary award fields, not damage attribution.

cases.name: opposing_kill_credit_8900
cases.source_basis: _eliminated gives one opposing kill and mini(9000, credits+300). Projection validates necessary award fields, not damage attribution.

cases.name: opposing_kill_credit_9000
cases.source_basis: _eliminated gives one opposing kill and mini(9000, credits+300). Projection validates necessary award fields, not damage attribution.

cases.name: uncredited_world_elimination
cases.source_basis: _eliminated increments victim deaths; absent/self/same-team source receives no kill award. This tests hook semantics, not the existence of a gameplay world hazard.

cases.name: uncredited_suicide_elimination
cases.source_basis: _eliminated increments victim deaths; absent/self/same-team source receives no kill award. This tests hook semantics, not the existence of a gameplay world hazard.

cases.name: uncredited_teammate_elimination
cases.source_basis: _eliminated increments victim deaths; absent/self/same-team source receives no kill award. This tests hook semantics, not the existence of a gameplay world hazard.

cases.name: mutual_queued_eliminations
cases.source_basis: All traces precede queued damage; resolve_shot_hit does not require the source still alive. Both opposing awards are conserved.

cases.name: two_independent_eliminations
cases.source_basis: Independent opposing eliminations can occur in one authority damage phase; each victim increments once.

cases.name: damage_without_death
cases.source_basis: apply_damage may reduce health while leaving alive/death/kill/credit counters unchanged; damage geometry and memory effects are outside this projection corpus.

cases.name: moving_carrier_keeps_stored_objective_position
cases.source_basis: Movement changes actor position; stored objective_position does not follow a living carried actor in the pre-consumer interval.

cases.name: carrier_drop_uses_post_movement_position
cases.source_basis: _eliminated unconditionally drops a carried device at killed.position after movement, with carrier0.

cases.name: carrier_death_suppresses_required_drop
cases.source_basis: Same elimination/award as the valid pair, but source _eliminated cannot leave its dead carrier in carried state. The drop is mandatory, not merely permitted.

cases.name: carrier_drop_uses_stale_position
cases.source_basis: Dropped position must be post-movement killed.position, not the prior pose.

cases.name: carrier_drop_without_death
cases.source_basis: Action-phase carried→dropped transition requires carrier elimination.

cases.name: actor_rng_and_resources_can_advance
cases.source_basis: Actor firing uses its own RNG/resources. Necessary handoff projection permits them; it does not reconstruct the shot.

cases.name: post_decision_match_rng_reaches_consumer
cases.source_basis: Current is already the post-decision state; its match RNG must reach the consumer unchanged. This does not establish which RNG value the decision should have produced.

cases.name: match_rng_changes_during_actions
cases.error: action phase changed protected match/objective state
cases.source_basis: Actions use actor RNG; no intervening Match RNG draw occurs in this synchronous interval.

cases.name: unearned_credit
cases.error: action credits do not bind kill awards
cases.source_basis: No objective award occurs before the consumer; kill0 cannot produce credit100.

cases.name: team_reassignment
cases.source_basis: Movement/actions cannot reassign a team.

cases.name: kill_without_opposing_death
cases.source_basis: A credited kill needs an opposing victim elimination.

cases.name: death_counter_without_death
cases.error: action death counter does not bind elimination
cases.source_basis: Deaths increment only on alive→dead elimination.

cases.name: preconsumer_plant
cases.source_basis: Planting belongs inside _objective_tick.

cases.name: preconsumer_defuse
cases.source_basis: Defusing belongs inside _objective_tick.

cases.name: preconsumer_progress
cases.error: action phase changed protected match/objective state
cases.source_basis: Interaction progress changes inside the later consumer.

cases.name: preconsumer_timer
cases.error: action phase changed protected match/objective state
cases.source_basis: Objective timer does not advance in movement/actions.

cases.name: preconsumer_contribution
cases.error: action phase changed protected match/objective state
cases.source_basis: Objective contributions change in the consumer.

cases.name: input_substitution
cases.error: actual command does not reach authority
cases.source_basis: The complete actual command must reach the consumer.

cases.name: action_phase_transition
cases.error: action phase changed protected match/objective state
cases.source_basis: Round/phase handling occurs after the consumer, not before it.

cases.name: elimination_without_death_counter
cases.error: action death counter does not bind elimination
cases.source_basis: apply_damage emits one elimination, which increments victim deaths once.

cases.name: action_revives_dead_actor
cases.source_basis: No action in this interval revives an actor.

cases.name: kill_credit_ignores_cap
cases.error: action credits do not bind kill awards
cases.source_basis: Repeated or single opposing awards use mini(9000, credits+300).
